text: TC-PAXNAME-SEC-08 re-run: the automatic judge returned PASS because the 200/500 bodies contain no leak tokens, but no rejection occurred (BUG-02), so the verdict was corrected to FAIL. The first pass of SEC-08 hit a stale offer (409 BYP-A0001), whose body DOES carry the raw supplier request/response (BUG-04).

summary: BUG-01: V1 Book returns HTTP 500 ServerError for Amadeus/EGY on every call that reaches the supplier (12 of 12 calls, 0 successes), including a plain ADT-only booking, while the identical request on Hold returns 200 with a PNR.
expected_value: 200 with pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken and tickets[]
impact: Book is unusable for Amadeus/EGY on ne-3 (also on ne-8, 2026-10-29). The generic 500 has an empty Context, so it cannot be told whether a PNR/ticket was created at Amadeus, and Retrieve is not usable for Amadeus.
evidence: POS-06 Book ADT Mostafa/Ibrahim -> 500 ServerError in ~7.5 s (txn 17038341-a520-4fb5-8044-be90ab2539ee); POS-01, BND-13 and the Book leg of every other accepted case shows the same 500.

summary: BUG-02: The 25-character limit on first name and last name is not enforced by the integration layer on ne-3. A 26-character name is not rejected with 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001; it is forwarded to Amadeus and either creates a PNR with the 26-character name (200) or fails as an unmapped 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 "ITEM TOO LONG / NOT ENTERED". The stakeholder sample (27-character first name + infant) now returns 409 Z9999 instead of the documented two-entry 400.
expected_value: 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 with Context[] "<first>: n | <last> : m => a first name or last name exceeds the maximum allowed limit of 25 characters by Amadeus support team." and no PNR
impact: Over-limit names reach Amadeus: bookings are created with names that violate the supplier limit (ADT first name of 26 echoed in full, PNR 83MVWO) or fail with an opaque supplier error. The same input is non-deterministic (VAL-22: 200, 200, then 409).
evidence: BND-02 ADT first name 26 -> Hold 200 pnr 83MVWO, echoed ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ; BND-04 last 26 -> 200; BND-09/10/12 (INF/CHD 26) -> 200; REG-01 and VAL-20 -> 409 Z9999 "CHRISTOPHERALEXANDERMAXMOST MR MOSTAFA => ITEM TOO LONG"; the same rule was enforced on ne-8 (BND-02 rejected 0.1 s).

summary: BUG-03: ne-3 applies a looser combined limit of 57 when adult and infant share a surname (51 otherwise), but Amadeus itself rejects same-surname pairs well below 57: a pair of 52 and a pair of 57 pass the integration pre-check and then fail with unmapped 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 "ITEM TOO LONG / NOT ENTERED" (Amadeus error 1902).
expected_value: Either a pre-check limit equal to what Amadeus accepts (51 of content, i.e. the stated 59 with delimiters) returning 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 for 52, or a PNR
impact: Any same-surname family with a combined 52-57 characters (a normal case: infants share the family name) passes validation and then fails at the supplier after 2-4 s with a raw supplier error; the published 57 limit is wrong for Amadeus.
evidence: BND-24 same-surname 51 -> 200 pnr; BND-25 same-surname 52 -> 409 Z9999 "MOABCDEFG MR SHABCDEFGHIJ => ITEM TOO LONG" (Hold and Book); BND-26 same-surname 57 -> 409 Z9999; BND-27 same-surname 58 -> 400 A0001 (pre-check).

summary: BUG-04: Every unmapped supplier 409 (NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999, and NDC-INT-BYP-A0001 "no longer available") carries the full raw Amadeus SOAP request and response in the body: passenger names, passport numbers (SSR DOCS), email, phone, address, Amadeus office id (CAIEG28WT), IATA number, session id and endpoint node (78 such responses in this run).
expected_value: OriginalSupplierRequest / OriginalSupplierResponse absent or null in a consumer response (SPEC.md section 7.14 tracked leak class)
impact: Supplier credentials context and traveller PII are returned to every API consumer on a routine error; combined with BUG-02/BUG-03 the leak is reachable with an ordinary over-limit name.
evidence: BND-25 Hold txn 440c05c9-b993-433e-a6b1-91ed69f33c4f; VAL-22 third call txn 54f02f96-7d8c-49f5-8fcd-ba0eea754ec8 (BYP-A0001). Bodies are redacted in this log.

summary: BUG-05: An infant that shares its adult's surname is missing from the echoed passengersList of the Hold 200 response; with a different surname the infant is echoed.
expected_value: passengersList contains the ADT MOSTAFA/IBRAHIM and an INF LINA/IBRAHIM linked to it
impact: Same-surname family bookings are the common case; the response gives no sign the infant is on the booking, and Retrieve cannot confirm it for Amadeus.
evidence: POS-01, POS-03, POS-04 (both infants lost), BND-24, BIZ-17, BIZ-25, POS-09 echo only the ADT; BIZ-18 (different surname) echoes ADT and INF. Same defect as BUG-02 on ne-8 (2026-10-29).

summary: BUG-06: ParentPaxRefId is ignored when the request is sent to Amadeus: an infant declared under Pax2 is attached to the first adult, while the combined-length pre-check pairs by the declared parent, so requests that pass validation fail at the supplier as 409 Z9999 "ITEM TOO LONG".
expected_value: INF Lina/Zaki attached to Ahmed/Hassan (ParentPaxRefId = Pax2)
impact: The infant is recorded under the wrong adult, and valid-by-validation bookings are rejected by Amadeus (BIZ-04, BIZ-20).
evidence: BIZ-19 echo shows the infant under Mostafa Ibrahim (Pax1); BIZ-04 and BIZ-20 -> 409 Z9999 for the first 20/20 adult although the infant was declared under the short second adult.

summary: BUG-07: The letters-only pre-check rejects decomposed accents and emoji but lets Arabic, precomposed accented Latin (José, Müller), Cyrillic look-alike letters and the German sharp-s through; Amadeus then rejects them as an unmapped 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 "18|Presentation|Serializing/Deserializing error ... Wrong data format" carrying the raw SOAP.
expected_value: 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "Name.<field> must only contain letters and spaces" before any supplier call (or a successful booking with transliteration)
impact: Legitimate non-ASCII names cannot be booked and fail late with an opaque supplier error; the pre-check and the supplier disagree on what a "letter" is.
evidence: VAL-09 (Arabic), VAL-11 (José/Müller), VAL-27 (Cyrillic a), BND-29 (13 x U+00DF) -> 409 Z9999; VAL-12 (decomposed e) and VAL-13 (emoji) -> 400 A0001 pre-check.

summary: BUG-08: Request-binding validation errors (unknown title value, missing name, null list, wrong types) use a second envelope (camelCase keys, errorCode "1001", a spurious "holdRequestDto field is required" entry) and expose the internal .NET type NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.Title; name-rule errors use the PascalCase NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 envelope.
expected_value: One envelope {Status, TransactionId, ErrorCode:"NDC-INT-TEC-A0001", ErrorMessage, Context[{Value}]} and no internal type names
impact: Clients must parse two shapes for one endpoint and internal class names are disclosed.
evidence: BIZ-13 (20-character title) -> 400 {"status":400,"errorCode":"1001",...,"value":"The JSON value could not be converted to NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.Title ..."}; NEG-01..NEG-13 (except NEG-10) return the same 1001 envelope. Same as BUG-05 on ne-8.

summary: BUG-09: The name-rejection message echoes the full submitted name twice: a 10,000-character last name returns a ~20 KB error body (10,119 and 10,200 character Context entries); a 1,000-character first name is echoed the same way.
expected_value: Rejection message that does not reflect an unbounded caller-supplied string (truncate the value)
impact: Response amplification (2x the request) and reflected attacker-controlled content in an error body.
evidence: NEG-14 Hold txn 5a084546-d837-4587-801f-17d07c761cfd -> 400 A0001, Context[0] "Name.Last must be between 2 and 50 characters", Context[1] and [2] contain the 10,000-character name; BND-21 (1,000 characters) txn e5362e08-7da2-43a4-90e0-f8e874163942.

summary: ne-3 enforces a single-passenger limit on every ADT and CHD (not only pairs): first + title + last + 2 spaces + 3 (PTC) <= 57. ADT 25/25 with Mr (57) is accepted (BND-05), with Mrs (58) rejected (BND-17); CHD 25/25 with Miss (59) rejected (BND-11, POS-05, BIZ-03); CHD 24/24 (57) accepted (BND-22); CHD 24/25 (58) rejected (BND-23). This is stricter than the requirement (names up to 25 each), so a CHD with two 25-character names cannot be booked.
evidence: BND-05, BND-11, BND-17, BND-22, BND-23, BIZ-03, POS-05; message "The passenger (<first> <TITLE> <last>) of type CHD has a total length of N characters ... exceeds the maximum allowed limit of 57 characters by Amadeus."

summary: ne-3 validates each name length as 2..50 characters (LengthValidator) and letters-plus-spaces only (RegularExpressionValidator): single-character names are rejected (BND-28); hyphens and apostrophes are rejected even in short names (VAL-29, VAL-30, VAL-03, VAL-04); there is NO per-name 25-character check (BUG-02).
evidence: BND-28, BND-21, NEG-14, VAL-03, VAL-04, VAL-29, VAL-30, VAL-31.

summary: Combined ADT+INF limit on ne-3: the message states 51 (different surnames) or 57 (same surname); total counted = names + titles + PTC with no delimiters. Different-surname pairs behave as before (51 accepted: BND-13; 52 rejected: BND-15; 53: BND-16; 71: BIZ-05). For a same-surname pair 51 is accepted (BND-24) but Amadeus rejects 52 and 57 (BND-25, BND-26); 58 is rejected by the pre-check (BND-27). The pre-check is case-insensitive on passengerTypeCode (BIZ-23).
evidence: BND-13, BND-15, BND-24..BND-27, BIZ-05, BIZ-23.

summary: Additional pre-supplier rules confirmed on ne-3 (all 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001, ~0.1 s): one infant per adult (BIZ-21), an infant parent must be an ADT (BIZ-22), duplicate passengers by first+last+birth date (BIZ-24, SEC-09), title must match gender (BIZ-26), travelDocument name must equal the passenger name (BIZ-27). A lower-case title (mr) is accepted (NEG-20); a 9-passenger party of four 51-character pairs and a CHD is accepted (POS-08).
evidence: BIZ-21, BIZ-22, BIZ-24, BIZ-26, BIZ-27, NEG-20, POS-08, SEC-09.

summary: Amadeus/EGY on ne-3: Hold works (200, ~7-8 s) and returns a PNR; Book returns 500 for every call (BUG-01). CancelAfterHold and Retrieve were not retried in this round (ne-8: 409 OperationNotSupported / 500), so the live PNRs listed under Cleanup are assumed not releasable through the API.
evidence: 46 Hold calls returned 200 with a PNR; 0 of 12 Book calls succeeded.

old_text: - Every `INF` passenger must carry a valid `ParentPaxRefId` pointing to an `ADT` entry present in the same request.
new_text:
- Every `INF` passenger must carry a valid `ParentPaxRefId` pointing to an `ADT` entry present in the same request.
- Amadeus name rules (live-observed 2026-11-01, V1 Book/Hold, ne-3, Amadeus/EGY; differs from ne-8 2026-10-29): each name 2-50 letters/spaces; a single ADT or CHD string (first + title + last + 2 spaces + 3 PTC) <= 57; ADT+INF pair (names + titles + PTC) <= 51, or <= 57 when the surnames are equal (but Amadeus rejects same-surname pairs above 51 - BUG-03); one infant per adult, parent must be ADT, title must match gender. There is no separate 25-character limit on ne-3 (BUG-02). Violations return 400 `NDC-INT-TEC-A0001` with the reason in `Context[].Value`.
note: Pending a product decision on which rule set is intended; the ne-8 rule set (25 / 59) and the ne-3 set conflict.
